desc: 淡纸草绿坐标纸底，赭黄标记条与干花静物讲机理用法
name: 纸面图鉴配方笔记精华液款

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼：产品全身直立于草绿纸底与浅方格坐标纹上，干净合规抢点击。
承接首屏：正侧剪影配一条赭黄荧光标记条，一秒讲清主诉求。
shots.textZone: upper band headline slot plus one ochre marker bar line beneath it

shots.intent: 把用户自己的四项面部困扰沿一条长虚线导轨摊开，勾住下滑。
shots.textZone: four rail labels in one row plus one short line inside the quote panel

shots.intent: 上下两张同框同光的细线剖面示意板，把两种状态并排交给买家自己判断。
shots.textZone: one short label under each of the two plates

shots.intent: 用一道涂在纸面上的样迹与取液口的极低角度微距证明质地，替代任何参数口播。
把产品放进干花与陶瓷的药剂师静物台面，让买家代入居家使用时刻。
用六行空白账页把规格信息交回真实资料，降风险而不写死任何数据。
shots.textZone: six row label and value slots on the ruled sheet

shots.intent: 垂直俯拍的纸面套装收口，一句主张加一枚空白按钮完成详情页最后一步。
shots.textZone: one closing line in the clear upper band above one blank pill button slot

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent paper-atelier formulation-note visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pale grass-paper #EDF0E4, deep pine ink-green #23473B, ochre marker accent #E3A21C and dried-flower lilac-grey #8C83A0; neutral-warm high-key studio lighting around 5200K with a large soft front key, a warm fill card, low-contrast paper bounce, one thin specular line only on the polished collar and single-direction soft contact shadows; background system of a pale grass-paper #EDF0E4 sheet with faint flat two-dimensional square drafting ruling, one solid deep pine #23473B full-width section band with a centred light caption, one scalloped torn-paper edge between pages and hairline-framed schematic plates, never a dark gradient space, never a perspective wireframe, never water; surfaces of matte pale paper board, translucent vellum, a ribbed matte ceramic dish and one deep pine painted shelf; narrow humanist sans-serif with wide-tracked small-caps kicker labels, hairline-ruled label rails and an ochre marker bar underlining one key line, no oversized numerals and no metallic gradient type; single-weight hairline pictograms drawn directly on the paper in #23473B keyed to small square tick marks in #8C83A0, no circle chips and no badges; stable upright product angle and scale with the product whole on every screen except the macro; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no water ripple or bubble or splash motif, no full-bleed dark indigo field, no perspective wireframe grid, no circular icon chips, no loose pearls, no oversized ghost numerals, no diagonal colour-block splits.
noDrift: no water ripple, bubble, splash or mist motif anywhere

style.surfaceSystem: matte pale paper board #EDF0E4 with faint drafting ruling, one sheet of translucent vellum laid at an angle, a ribbed matte ceramic dish and one deep pine #23473B painted shelf for the still-life screen
style.typography: narrow humanist sans-serif only; wide-tracked small-caps kicker labels and hairline-ruled label rails, an ochre marker bar underlining one key line; no oversized numerals and no metallic gradient type; headline 30-42pt, subtitle 15-20pt, label 11-15pt; all rendered copy stays short and placeholder-driven
